scope.exact_tree_semantics: finite graph coalgebras, including infinite trees; inclusion by complete product-graph reachability
scope.exhaustive_syntax: n=0,1; leaves bottom/variables and one product over leaves; every query and zero/one premise
scope.fixed_addresses: all binary words of length <=4 on named/seeded cases
scope.normalized_value_domain: all assignments of bottom,unit,zeroSpine,fullTree when output variables <=4
scope.not_claimed: not an exhaustive arbitrary-tree theorem, unrestricted decision, or Lean proof
scope.seeded: 250 finite DAG inputs; five original valuations and fresh-value mutations per input
